name: Shooter
description: Wheel, hood and the shot's flight, played out.
tip: See what a wheel speed and a hood angle do to a shot, and how fast the wheel recovers.

name: Elevator
description: Stages, rigging, speed and holding power.
tip: Size the motor and reduction for a lift, and watch the stages move.

name: Arm
description: Torque through the swing and time to move.
tip: Check that an arm can hold and move its load at every angle.

name: Drivetrain
description: Top speed, sprint times and wheel slip.
tip: Race two gearings over a distance to see which one gets there first.

name: Intake
tip: Make sure the rollers pull a game piece in faster than the robot drives onto it.

name: Belt, chain and gear spacing
description: Centre distances for pulleys, sprockets and gears.
tip: Find the hole spacing that makes a belt, chain or gear pair fit.

name: Gear ratio
description: Build a reduction stage by stage, or find parts for one.
tip: See speed and torque through each stage, and which stock gears reach a ratio.

name: Motors
description: Torque, current and power curves, compared.
tip: Compare motors under the current limit you will really run.

name: Battery and breakers
description: What the robot pulls, and when it browns out.
tip: Add up the current of every mechanism and see the battery voltage sag.

name: Pneumatics
description: Air used against what the tanks hold.
tip: Check that the tanks and compressor keep up with the cylinders.

name: Tip-over
description: Centre of gravity and how hard you can brake.
tip: Find where the robot's weight sits and when it tips.

name: Tube strength
description: How far a tube bends and when it yields.
tip: Pick a tube size and wall for an arm or a frame member.

name: Holes and fasteners
description: Drill sizes for taps, rivets, bearings and inserts.
tip: Look up the drill for a thread, a rivet or a press fit.

name: Unit conversion
description: One number in every unit of its kind.
tip: Convert a length, a force, a torque or a speed between inch and metric units.

name: Code constants
description: Gearing and wheel size as the numbers robot code needs.
tip: Turn gearing and wheel size into the conversion factors for code.

name: Drawing to vector
description: A photo of a drawing becomes a laser or CAD file.
tip: Make an SVG for the laser and a DXF for Onshape, at true size.

name: Gear and sprocket finder
description: A photo and one measurement name the part.
tip: Work out gear pitch, chain size or belt profile, then find it in Parts.
